name: Raphael Haase
headline: Mobile & AI | CDTM, TUM, Berkeley, HKUST, BMW, eGym, Deutsche Bahn, Flowable, Gerresheimer, Netlight, Rhenus, DAAD, EXIST, FNF, ENB
summary:
"Stay hungry, stay foolish."

Hi, I am Raphael!

A curious developer by training myself and passionate about all things medical and finance.
Reach out for a chat or coffee somewhere around the awesome globe!

How I got here: 

🛠 In the past, I engineered applications and coached teams from The Munich Airport, XING (amiando), Deutsche Bahn, e.on, eGym, HEAVN, BMW, Rhenus Logistics, KleverKey, Sensile Medical (Gerresheimer), a major financial institution from Liechtenstein, Flowable and BLS. 

🎓 I studied Computer Science at Technische Universität München (TUM), the University of California, Berkeley, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) and Technology Management at the CDTM in Munich.

⌨️ Developing software since 1995.

✅ Choose me: You might not know this, but there are few all-rounders out there. By covering requirements engineering, architecture as well as implementation I can lead your mission-critical greenfield project and take your app from zero to store. 

🥶 If you don’t know what you are looking for quite yet, let’s get in touch and we can break the ice with one of these topics:

🐴 Horses
🚠 Travel
💃 Swing dance

positions.title: Senior Mobile Architect
positions.description:
Crafting and managing reliable software solutions for medical and finance.

The desire to have an app is common, particularly among your challenging patients from this generation and the next. It's a deciding factor for doctors, patients, and insurance entities when pondering over buying or proposing your products. Today's patients, for instance, anticipate reminders for medication intake, blood pressure tracking, syncing essential health records with the cloud, and receiving prompt medical advice from their physicians.

Sounds like a regulatory challenge? Yes - but a challenge we can overcome together.

For example, I helped Gerresheimer bring a proof-of-concept app on iOS for a new Bluetooth-based product until a refined stage where it could be handed in for FDA review in under 2 years.

Become digital today, win the trust of your patients and deliver your management and stakeholders the results they are yearning for.
